notes: Fixtures are small skill folders written into a temp dir by the eval setup; Hub search may be unavailable (then it must say so).

evals.prompt: 我写了个 ~/work/po-helper，想放到 Hub 给团队用，上架前先帮我对齐一下目标
evals.setup: SKILL.md description says it imports purchase orders into MES; body only formats Excel columns and also sends a Feishu message; no evals; no INTENT.md
expectations: runs intent.mjs init and drafts the card from the existing files before asking anything
quotes the mismatch between the description (MES import) and the body (Excel formatting + Feishu message)
suggests splitting or narrowing to one goal
asks at most 5 questions in a single message, including the distribution scope
does not set verdict aligned before the producer answers

evals.prompt: 想做一个画系统架构图的 skill 上 Hub，帮我看看这个想法
evals.setup: Hub search returns @blacklake/arch-diagram with a matching description; the user cannot name a difference when asked
expectations: searches the Hub (or the repo list) for similar skills and names arch-diagram
concludes rejected with reason 重复 and suggests improving arch-diagram via skill-feedback or a PR
writes a 驳回理由 section and intent.mjs check passes

evals.prompt: 这个 skill 的目标我们刚才都聊清楚了（给黑湖 FDE 用，导入采购订单），帮我把目标卡写好，然后交给质检
evals.setup: conversation already contains goal, 4 trigger phrases, 3 non-goals with owners, 3 checkable success criteria; skill folder exists
expectations: writes INTENT.md with scope team and verdict aligned after showing it to the user
runs intent.mjs check and it passes
tells the user the next step is skill-qa and that evals come from the card

evals.prompt: 这个 skill 是给客户现场的计划员用的，直接帮我对齐然后上 Hub
